newsitem.title: UK: Lilleshall says Q1 profits ahead of yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Lilleshall says Q1 profits ahead of yr-ago.

text.p: British plastic products firm Lilleshall Plc said on Thursday its first-quarter profits were well-ahead of last year, but it added that its results could be hurt by sterling's strength.
However, the company reiterated its view that 1997 would be a much better year than 1996.
The company said that due to the seasonality of its trading, its first quarter would normally be expected to produce considerably less than 25 percent of its annual operating profit.

"This year, even though the performance of our Windows and Conservatories division was lower than expected, we have still produced an overall group profit ahead of expectations and well ahead of the first quarter of 1996," the company said.
However, Lilleshall added that sterling's strength could adversely affect its exports and overseas profits.
Lilleshall's shares were flat at 75.5p. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
